subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-shaped internal traces be blocked by a shared outbound sanitizer or by a Discord-specific front-channel sanitizer?
rationale: The fix protects a real user-visible security boundary, but overmatching can hide legitimate code or JSON while undermatching continues to expose internal tool routing metadata.

options.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
options.body: Extend the existing shared delivery scaffolding sanitizer to cover envelope-shaped internal traces, with cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

options.title: Discord-specific sanitizer
options.body: Keep the broader rule in Discord reply/send delivery and prove that sibling channels either already sanitize or are tracked by their own canonical issues.

options.title: Defer to broader policy
options.body: Block this issue behind the broader inter-tool text leakage policy and accept that the Discord envelope variants remain open until that decision lands.

recommendation.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
recommendation.body: Extend the existing shared delivery scaffolding sanitizer to cover envelope-shaped internal traces, with cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent history across both the shared tool-call repair package and Discord reply-safety code that would be touched by either implementation path.
